scope: Independent, read-only review of Dr. Social model-sheet candidate v3 against the approved v2 matrix and the user request. Inspect late-19th-century London costume cues across views; face, palette, scale and style continuity; shoulder-to-hand continuity and hand grips in the signature action; distinction between the blunt walking cane and separate rapier; boomerang read; every labeled equipment silhouette; ruler, baseline, label/card readability and crop integrity. Specifically report whether the throwing arm appears attached and whether the cane is unmistakably not a sword in the action pose.
reviewer_constraints: Read-only independent reviewer; do not edit, replace or promote any file.
Assess the exact candidate hash and compare against the supplied approved reference; stale files block review.
Report evidence-based defects, risks and opportunities separately, with at most three revision priorities.
Do not claim AAA, sprite, animation, SMS conversion, ROM or delivery approval.
The source-game equipment panel is reference-only; do not treat it as approval of the fan-game moveset.
